text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I have something to report.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I took a physical fitness test during
today's gym class, and I found that my
parameters have increased by 1.3 times
on average compared with
last year.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Of particular note is my shuttle run
result, which
has improved by 150%.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
In other words, your training has been of
great
statistical significance to my
growth.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
It is for this reason that I am giving you
this
mundane object to show my
appreciation.

With that, she hands me some special
carrot juice.
I've heard it's popular
among the students.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I decided on this after researching the
traditional
etiquette for showing
gratitude. It is only a small
gift.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to our continued
collaboration.

All "small gifts" aside,
our training seems
to be
going well!
